decisions.reason: The semi-hard cheese wheel was promoted from a mention in 2018 to a page of its own in 2019, which signals visible commitment and investment, and as a cheese it fits the firm's core range, so management will likely persist despite having little evidence on its results.

The spicy cheese also gained a dedicated page in 2019 and belongs to the cheese assortment the firm has been building, so sunk costs and the need to justify the earlier launch favour keeping it, although niche flavoured variants carry somewhat higher risk.

The mild creamy soft cheese was publicly announced as the product rounding off the new range and later given its own page, so this public, branded commitment makes management especially inclined to keep it.
